name: iD Tech Camps at Villanova University
description_short: Week long tech camps on the Villanova University campus for ages 7 to 17, with day camp for all ages and overnight stays from age 10. Kids pick a course in coding, game design, robotics, 3D printing or AI and work in small groups in campus labs, with outdoor breaks and a Friday family showcase.
refund_policy_summary: Unlimited changes with no fee up to 28 days before the session. Full refund for cancellations before March 1; after March 1 and at least 28 days out, refund less a $250 per week cancellation charge and any added fees. No refunds within 28 days of the start date.
special_needs_notes: Students of all abilities welcome; families should contact iD Tech at least three weeks before camp to plan accommodations.

sessions.name: Day and overnight weeks (course dates vary)

notes: Day camp 9 to 4:30 Monday to Thursday, check in from 8:30, pick up until 5; Friday ends with a 2 to 3 PM family showcase. Overnight campers check in Sunday at 6 PM and stay in campus residence halls with all meals in the dining hall. Day campers bring lunch or buy a lunch plan (cost not posted). Price is the posted starting price; payment plan available, $50 off for multiple sessions.
